Chapter 409 - 409 Super Batteries; Buying Clothes! (2)

409 Super Batteries; Buying Clothes! (2)

“Goodbye, Lin Fan.”

“Goodbye,” the students said.

Lin Fan did not turn around. Instead, he waved his hand behind him.

Soon, he arrived at the library.

As usual, the library was overcrowded.

Lin Fan passed through the crowd, past the history bookshelves, and past the language bookshelves… He went straight to the battery and new energy bookshelf.

The Safety Analysis of Electric Vehicle Power Batteries, The Engineering of Batteries…

Ordinary people might have to search for the books slowly.

However, with a single glance, Lin Fan easily found all the books he needed.

Then, Lin Fan looked into the distance.

A female student in a gray dress with her hair hanging naturally on her shoulders was sitting there reading seriously.

It was Lu Ling, whom Lin Fan often met.

There were many books on the table next to Lu Lin, indicating that there was someone sitting there.

Lin Fan did not mind at all as he strode over.

Lu Ling seemed to have noticed something and slowly raised her head.

When she saw that it was Lin Fan, her brows, which were originally slightly furrowed because of the difficult questions, immediately relaxed. She said happily, “You’re here? Sit down.”

Lin Fan did not stand on ceremony and sat down.

Then, he flipped open the first book, The Safety Analysis of Electric Vehicle Power Batteries…

Immediately, there was a rush of flipping of pages.

In three minutes, a book with hundreds of pages had been flipped through.

Then, it was the second book, The Engineering of Batteries…

The third book, The Technology Basics of Electric Vehicles…

In just ten minutes, Lin Fan had finished reading all five books.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Mission completed. [Ding! Mission: Watch a battery experiment (1/1). Read The Safety Analysis of Electric Vehicle Power Batteries, The Engineering of Batteries, The Technology Basics of Electric Vehicles, The Powertrain of Electric Vehicles, and The Theory of Vehicle Batteries (5/5). Reward: One ultra-speed battery, as well as its detailed research and development data, principles, etc., and your chemistry experience will be upgraded.]

[Ding! Chemistry Professor-Level Experience upgraded to Chemistry Academician Experience!]

All of a sudden, a vast amount of complicated chemistry knowledge, as well as complicated battery structures and principles, flooded into Lin Fan’s mind like a tidal wave.

Lin Fan thought back to the things that this knowledge would bring him. His lips curled up slightly, revealing a faint smile.

Lu Ling saw that Lin Fan had finished flipping through all the books.

She could not help but ask, “Lin Fan, are you done reading?”

Lin Fan nodded. “Yeah.”

“You really don’t know quantum reading?” Lu Ling asked again.

Lin Fan smiled. “That’s just a trick.”

“Alright,” Lu Ling said.

“You seem to be reading battery books again?”

“Yes, but this time, it’s a new energy battery for cars,” Lin Fan said.

Then, Lin Fan pointed at the questions written on the notebook in front of Lu Lin and asked, “Are these the questions that you don’t know how to solve?”

Speaking of these questions, Lu Ling could not help but nod shyly.

Lin Fan casually glanced at them and wrote the solutions down without thinking.

The tip of the pen collided with the table, making a hurried sound.

Very soon, a series of very detailed calculations appeared on the notebook.

A moment later, Lin Fan stood up and said, “Take your time.”

Although Lu Ling had seen Lin Fan answer difficult questions quickly many times, each time she saw him write out extremely detailed answers without thinking, she could not help but be surprised.

After a while, she stammered, “Okay… Alright.”

Lin Fan did not hear this voice.

It was because he had already walked out of the library and arrived at the parking lot.

Lin Fan got into the Cullinan, stepped on the accelerator, and sped forward.

In just 20 minutes, he returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Then, Lin Fan turned his attention to the system.

[Do you want to retrieve the super battery?]

“Yes!”

The next moment, a battery pack that looked like a desktop computer appeared in front of him.

Lin Fan sized it up and muttered, “Is this a super battery? It’s not big.”

Then, he lifted it with his hands and said, “About 20 kilograms. It’s not too heavy.”

Then, Lin Fan looked at the black super smart watch on his wrist and said, “Lil White.”

“Master, I’m here.”

The super smart watch flickered slightly and made a crisp sound.

“Help me apply for the patent for this super battery.” Lin Fan pointed at the battery in front of him.

“Alright, Master,” Lil White said.

As soon as it finished speaking, the super smart watch shot out a red scanning line.

A few minutes later…

“Master, the global patent application has been completed.”

Then…

Electronic patent documents appeared on the screen of the super smart watch.

Lin Fan nodded his head in satisfaction and said, “By the way, Lil White, can you write a paper on this super battery?”

Every time he watched an experiment, he would have to write a thesis.

This had almost become a habit for Lin Fan.

“Master, I’ve already written it,” Lil White said.

Lil White seemed to have predicted that Lin Fan would need such a thesis.

Almost as soon as it finished speaking, an email popped up on Lin Fan’s phone.

It was titled ‘The Principle and Use of Super Batteries!’

In fact, Lil White even wrote Lin Fan’s name on the position of the first author.

Li Rongfa and Zhao Xueqing names were placed as the second author.

Lin Fan was satisfied. “Good job!”

“I sent it to Science last time, so this time… Nature!”

“Lil White, tell the editor of Nature to review it as soon as possible.”

“Yes, Master!” Lil White replied.

..

It was midnight in America.

In the house of Esmond Bevan, the editor of Nature, all kinds of electrical appliances suddenly started ringing.

However, he was not afraid or angry.

On the contrary, he became extremely excited and quickly turned on his computer.

Sure enough, an email appeared on the screen.

“The Principle and Use of Super Batteries!”

Esmond Bevan did not read the content immediately but flipped to the author page.

“First author, Lin Fan of Jiangbei University!

“It really is him, haha! That’s great!”

After Esmond Bevan finished speaking, he began to read the content carefully from beginning to end.

As he continued reading, Esmond Bevan became more and more excited.

“A new energy car, this is a new energy car!

“If the data on it is accurate…

“It will completely overturn the entire automobile industry!”

At this point, Esmond Bevan quickly took out his phone and dialed the number of the managing editor.

Not long after, the chemistry laboratory at Hemp Rope Technology University lit up.

Even though it was midnight, many white-haired chemistry experts drove to the laboratory and could not wait to do complicated experiments.

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

Originally, he wanted to go to school for classes today.

After all, he had not been to class for a few days, but he had encountered a mission.

Additionally, he had already returned home.

He was too lazy to go to school.

When he arrived at school the next day, he realized that it was Saturday.

Lin Fan hesitated for a moment before driving the Cullinan to Yi Ke City.

At this moment, Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling were sitting on the sofa watching a movie.

When they saw Lin Fan’s smiling face, they quickly went forward and held Lin Fan’s arms.

Lin Fan looked at how happy they were. It was as if he had been infected and was very happy as well.

Then, he took out his phone and transferred ten million yuan to each of them. “I transferred some money to you guys to buy some clothes.”

Huang Ling felt the phone in her pocket vibrate and picked it up out of habit.

The next moment, she immediately opened her mouth wide and said, “Ten million!”

Qiu Ziqian was also shocked. She leaned her head on Lin Fan happily.

Then, she whispered into Lin Fan’s ear, “Actually, we’ve already bought a lot of clothes. Nurses, teachers, nannies, white-collar workers, cats, dogs…”
